_note: Single source of truth for RULES (as specs/ is for geometry). Every rule is one entry, never restated in prose. Precedence: higher wins; the loser gets status 'superseded' + superseded_by and is NEVER deleted. 'key' identifies the decision a rule governs; two ACTIVE rules on the same key with different statements = conflict (policy/check.py STOPs). Docs reference IDs, never values.

rules.statement: 1:1 square, 2048x2048 minimum, native, no upscale
all images portrait
metal read from source into specs/<SKU>.json; no document-level default; 14K only a tiebreaker when source ambiguous AND Etsy title says 14K
default 18K natural yellow gold unless source otherwise
the source CAD is the only truth; AI redraw disabled; geometry from source pixels only
exactly 4 studio (white velvet) + 6 lifestyle; one image per angle/pose
camera defined by numeric azimuth/elevation/crop per slot; filenames carry no geometry; within-group pairwise separation 20az/15el
ring studio 4 = top_down, true_side (edge-on stone), front_elevation, gallery_back (rear 3/4, filigree gallery + back of shank); gallery_back replaces macro_head
studio slot 04 = macro_head
jewellery is the subject; no kissing/faces-in-contact/embrace/suggestive; couple never outweighs the ring
exclude any source watermark/hallmark/vendor/engraved mark; inner shank plain; only the official Lucent logo permitted
band arms both terminate on the same finger/wrist; band crossing an inter-finger gap = FAIL; bracelet must close
ring centre between MCP and PIP of one finger; webbing/over-knuckle/past-fingertip = FAIL
MediaPipe: 5 digits, correct joints, detection confidence >0.8; fused/extra/missing digits or impossible thumb = FAIL
support/gravity, occlusion, light consistency, scale, reflection sanity â€” mandatory visual checklist on EVERY render until automated
exposure-normalized skin high-frequency energy above threshold; plastic/over-smoothed skin = FAIL
medias[0] is a distinct per-slot reference from refs/<SKU>/; --stage prompts hard-fails if any missing
every lifestyle reference is a real camera photograph (no AI/render), unambiguous one-finger placement, real skin detail
Higgsfield generation call frozen: text-to-image, 2k/1:1/count1/one batch, medias [pose/studio ref, SOURCE piece]; no img2img/denoise/compositing of jewelry (accent-run composite exception approved)

Higgsfield call feeds the matching source-CAD angle as a structure-lock REFERENCE (image-to-image / subject-preserve) so the exact ring geometry is held while only the scene changes; medias [pose/studio ref, SOURCE piece]; 2k/1:1/count1/one batch. Per HIGGSFIELD_ONLY, all delivered pixels come from Higgsfield and Python never composites/writes delivered pixels. Supersedes the earlier text-to-image/no-img2img call.
never spawn subagent/background-task/agent; read source in-thread once; no gallery-display widgets; job_display retrieval only, one pass per catalog

never spawn subagent/background-task/agent; read source in-thread once. NO Higgsfield widgets/galleries of any kind, INCLUDING job_display, show_generations, show_marketing_studio_generations, media_upload_widget or any gallery/grid/preview/widget tool. Take a generation's URL/ID only from its own result already in hand; the user previews results in Higgsfield. Silent operation: one short final status line, no in-chat image previews.
the Lucent logo is only the locked composited asset on studio cloth; AI never draws a logo; no AI text on studio renders
<=15k tokens per catalog; savings come only from what is displayed, never from source fidelity, prompt detail, or validation
studio background is premium plain pure-white velvet only (low saturation, high luminance, fine fabric texture); reject coloured backgrounds, seamless paper, hard gradients, props
permissions granted once; run every catalog end-to-end with no check-ins; internal output only; user reviews after completion
quality only ratchets up; a gate that stops catching a past failure fails the build; goldens are permanent
Higgsfield MCP is the only production image-generation engine; never swap providers
per-catalog order P0-P9: source gate -> spec -> prompts -> frozen batch -> validate -> retry -> download(deliveries/) -> manifest -> failure memory -> commit+push
one coherent theme within a catalog; a different theme per catalog rotated by SKU hash
genuine photography, varied non-generic models/wardrobe; banned beige/cream/oatmeal knit, neutral couch, seamless backdrop in a lifestyle frame
all render outputs live in the single store deliveries/<SKU>/ (gitignored); images never committed
every item a studio slot reveals must be established by a supplied source view (config/view_coverage.json); + azimuth within 45deg; else block. No inference, no category priors, no defaults

Jewellery is composited from source CAD cutouts (whole-asset affine transform only); Higgsfield generates BACKGROUND PLATES ONLY (call shape unchanged: 2k,1:1,count1,one batch); no jewellery word or geometry in any prompt.

every delivery carries its source cutout name + sha256 and asserts whole-asset affine only; no sidecar or hash mismatch = no ship. Pixel-counters G2-G9 retired for composites; geometry verified by cutout hash.

ALL delivered pixels come from Higgsfield generate_image. Call shape frozen: medias [reference, SOURCE piece], 2k, 1:1, count 1, one batch per catalog. Python may NOT create or alter delivered pixels (no compositing, cutout-into-output, PIL paste, affine placement, relight, shadow synthesis, any pixel write). Python allowed only for read-only gates, spec/prompt building, download, manifests, failure memory, hashing, hygiene. Geometry enforcement = catch-and-retry: every render gated, any geometry fail auto-regenerates, max 5 rounds, then STOP and report.

lifestyle jewellery bounding box >= 12% of frame area (>= 25% on the two macro lifestyle slots); below threshold the model cannot resolve real geometry and substitutes a generic piece -> FAIL, regenerate with tighter framing.

every stone in the output equals its source counterpart: count, shape per stone, cut/facet pattern, absolute size, size RELATIVE to every other stone, orientation/tilt, setting/prong style, spacing/arrangement. Band profile/width/contour/silhouette/taper/metal identical. Only camera angle and scene may change. Locked numeric ratios live in specs/<SKU>.json.stone_equality and are stated in every prompt.

Higgsfield generates 100% of every scene (velvet, cloth, hands, skin, wardrobe, environment, light, shadow). The jewellery layer is PLACED from the source CAD cutout by affine transform only (scale/rotate/translate) — never redrawn, never generatively filled inside the jewellery bounds. Text-to-image cannot hold stone-size ratios (proven LR-0203/0206/0211, 3%-53% framing); this path makes geometry exact by construction.

on every on-hand/lifestyle image the ring is at true real-life scale: the centre stone sits WITHIN the finger's width (stone width <= finger width), never wider/oversized/cocktail-huge; an elongated stone spans ALONG the finger but must not overhang the finger sides. Reject if the diamond looks oversized for the hand.

Jewellery redesign/redraw PROHIBITED: diamond shape/size/cut/facet/count/placement, prongs/setting/gallery/band and metalwork come ONLY from the source CAD, unchanged (target: D2D pixel-perfect), on EVERY image including lifestyle. Only the camera angle may change. Read ALL source angles before generating; never generate an angle without a source view. Materials must look 100% real (no plastic/CZ/CGI). Aspirational under HIGGSFIELD_ONLY (text-to-image cannot guarantee D2D); kept as the locked target and enforced where measurable (G22 scale, G20 framing, G12 marks, G-INVENT coverage).
engine frozen to Higgsfield nano_banana_2 (2k, 1:1); never switch/redesign/migrate to Nano Banana Pro or any other generator; visual-generation behaviour must not change

Nano Banana 2 is the ONLY image-generation model — every image, every catalog, every slot, no exception. The model string is params.model='nano_banana_2' (verified against the Higgsfield catalog: id 'nano_banana_2' = 'Nano Banana 2', Google). BANNED, reject the call: nano_banana_pro, nano_banana_flash, nano_banana_2_lite, nano_banana_2_shots, seedream_v5_pro, or any string that is not nano_banana_2. ENFORCED IN CODE not prose: config/model.json holds the one string; build_prompts.locked_model() and preflight.assert_model() read it; preflight raises on mismatch before the call; `python scripts/preflight.py --check-model` prints it. Every manifest records the model actually used; a manifest showing any other model = catalog FAIL, regenerate. Call shape: medias [reference, SOURCE piece], 2k, 1:1, count 1, one batch. ACKNOWLEDGED TRADEOFF: this model redraws geometry — count/prong/size ratios can drift; G21 (STONE_MATCH), G2 (STONE_COUNT), G7 (PRONG_CHECK) run BLOCKING with auto-retry (max 5 rounds); a slot that does not converge is delivered labelled GEOMETRY APPROXIMATE. CORRECTION 2026-08-01: an earlier same-day entry wrongly said use 'nano_banana_pro' (that is Nano Banana PRO, a different, banned model); recorded, not deleted.

Every stone crystal/water-clear on every slot: colourless, fully transparent, glass-bright, flawless, crisp sharply-defined facet edges, true white brilliance with sharp fire and defined scintillation, clean bright table/crown, crisp pavilion reflections, every stone equally clean and bright. Verbatim positive clause + verbatim banned-terms in every prompt. G24 checks (a) per-stone luminance, (b) facet-edge sharpness, (c) colour neutrality, (d) consistency; any fail auto-regenerates. Lifestyle: piece must sit in direct light, not hand shadow (shadowed stone fails regardless of prompt). Thresholds calibrated against tests/golden clarity goldens (FP=0).

Karat is ALWAYS 18K (solid gold). Colour: yellow or rose source -> that colour wins at 18K; anything not clearly white -> 18K yellow (pure) gold by default. One colour across all 10 slots. DECISION (user 2026-08-01): when the SOURCE is WHITE GOLD or PLATINUM, do NOT auto-render — STOP and CONFIRM with the user per catalog whether to render 18K WHITE (source colour) or 18K YELLOW; wait for the answer, spend nothing until confirmed. Karat is not visually measurable -> enforced by prompt (build_prompts states '18K') and AUDITED against the Etsy listing (flag mismatches), NOT by pixels. Enforced by G25 (GOLD_CHECK): rendered metal colour must match the confirmed spec gold colour (cross-family fail on studio slots; white-spec reading coloured fails anywhere). Coexists with METAL_SOURCE_GOVERNED (colour measured from source); this rule sets karat=18K, the yellow default, and the white-gold confirm-first gate.

Engine 1 higgsfield is the production default and the ONLY catalog-approved stills engine; engine 2 openflow is opt-in for video/exploration, never auto-selected, never a fallback, never writes a delivered image

Project policy outranks every engine, mode, model and tool; whatever mode is used in future must still run through these policies, and an engine that cannot satisfy a blocking rule is refused, never the rule
